chapter: Touring in the bus years and Jim Crow in the South
title: Rene Hall's New York trips and the Bill Robinson tour
summary: Rene went on several New York trips, and a 1943-44 write-up covers the tour with Bill Robinson.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Rene--I believe Rene left me along about--
He didn't go to New York with you?

Oh yeah, Rene went with me; definitely. Rene and me made several trips to New York. He made the original with me and of course he was the one that I said when we came back (inaudible), but we made several trips back and Rene was still in the band.
I wish you would pause just a moment here and check a write up here, I believe
it was forty-four, forty three or four, when Rene was still in the band when we were with Bill Robinson.
I remember it very well, the Pittsburgh Courier.
And for a couple of years were always on top.
